title: Remote Work Tax Mapper
description: Calculates state income tax liability across all 50 states + DC for remote workers. Embeds full state tax rates, reciprocity pairs, NY/PA convenience-of-employer rules, and 2025 federal brackets for single/MFJ. Compares three scenarios: current arrangement, move to employer state, and 100% WFH in a no-tax state.
data_vintage: 2025 state income tax rates, 2025 IRS federal brackets, FICA 2025 ($176,100 SS wage base)

mcp_tool_definition.name: map_remote_work_tax
mcp_tool_definition.description: Given residence state, employer state, salary, and filing status, returns state + federal + FICA tax across three scenarios. Flags NY convenience-of-employer doctrine and reciprocity agreements. Uses embedded 2025 rate data. Deterministic.

regulatory_citations: IRS Revenue Procedure 2024-61 — 2025 Tax Inflation Adjustments
Tax Foundation 2025 State Individual Income Tax Rates
NY Tax Law §631 — Convenience of Employer doctrine
